title: When the Portrait Breaks Again
author: P. M. Thornbury
blurb: Sebastian Eriksen, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
